requirements.requirement: One genomic region can have different promoter/transcript and coding contexts; a gene name does not identify one retained message or product.
The stipulated V position is coding in transcriptA but retained untranslated sequence in transcriptB with a downstream translation start.
Alignment gaps preserve genomic coordinates in the drawing, while the processed RNA is continuous; picture gaps are not missing RNA molecules.
Retained exons can contain untranslated sequence, and functional noncoding RNA need not make protein.
Variant/product descriptions require the exact transcript accession and version rather than a gene name alone.
Promoters, exon widths, coding boundaries and coordinates are fictional and do not measure transcript abundance or protein production.
The selected model contains two domains on one continuous linker-connected chain; corrective calls do not make an extra connecting bridge a separate biological fact.
The same stipulated local domain folds can have different relative arrangements and interdomain gaps.
Local fold confidence does not establish confidence in relative placement or an interdomain pocket.
A proposed interdomain pocket is an empty cleft between surfaces in the stipulated model, not the linker, one domain interior or a validated ligand interaction.
Alternative hypothetical arrangements are not observed motion or disorder, and confidence is not experimental verification.
A model arrangement, gap or palette does not establish binding affinity, activity, drug action or clinical benefit.
An unchanged ligand can bind and be released reversibly; that does not itself depict chemical transformation.
The separate stipulated bond-cleavage example changes substrate into products while retaining atoms and reusing the enzyme.
The simple one-site equilibrium occupancy model uses free ligand and identical independent sites without a competitor; total added ligand is a different input.
Free ligand equal toKd at10nM yields one-half model occupancy; five of ten icons is an illustration rather than a guaranteed realised sample.
Kd, Km and assayIC50 have different definitions and conditions; their numerical equality is not automatic.
Binding affinity for one partner does not establish selectivity against other partners.
Occupancy, catalytic change, downstream cellular effect and cell death require separate evidence; none establishes patient benefit.
A partial agonist has a lower maximum in the stated system, which differs from a full agonist observed at a low concentration.
Neutral blockade leaves the stipulated baseline unchanged whereas inverse agonism reduces the constitutive baseline under the stated conditions.
The neutral antagonist can reduce response when a reference agonist is present; that separate condition is distinct from changing baseline alone.
The five stated fictional response functions give limiting full/partial/neutral/inverse responses100/40/10/5, and reference-agonist response80 tending to10 with increasing antagonist.
The fictional full-agonist response atc=0.5 is40, matching the partial curve limiting value without making the full agonist a partial agonist.
Concentration axes are logarithmic and exclude zero; different vertical scales and limiting plateaus cannot be read as equal finite endpoints or comparable image distances.
Equal chosen curve midpoints are a design assumption, not observed equal potency; receptor abundance, coupling, endpoint, toxicity and constitutive activity matter.
The curves are an invented response assay, not measured receptor occupancy, doses, toxicity-driven reductions, clinical efficacy or a universal response law.
A generic branched connection map is not experimentally established causal wiring in every tumour.
Membrane-associatedRAS is represented as a GTP/GDP switch rather than a kinase.
A selected noncatalytic scaffold can hold partners; signalling roles are not all catalytic phosphate transfers.
A kinase transfers phosphate fromATP to a substrate withADP produced; phosphorylation is not universally activating.
Removing substrate phosphate is a different reaction and does not automatically regenerateATP.
The fictional siteX decrease at30minutes and unchanged count at2days are different measurements with different timing and denominators.
The two readouts alone do not establish direct target engagement, growth dependence or patient benefit.
Cell icons stand for a count assay rather than three actual measured cells; symbols and arrows do not supply sample sizes or effect estimates.
Separate estrogen/ER and progesterone/PR examples depict classical intracellular transcription regulation, not anER-PR complex.
The classical example does not mean all hormone effects require transcription, all genes increase or every receptor permanently resides in the nucleus.
In the selected EGF/EGFR example ligand binding is extracellular and kinase signalling is intracellular; the two-receptor/two-ligand scene is not a universal stoichiometry.
A growth-signalling relay does not establish cell division, a measured growth percentage or a guaranteed response.
MembranePD-L1 on a neighbouring cell can contactPD-1 on a responding T cell, with inhibitory signalling in the T-cell compartment.
The neighbour need not be a tumour cell, and dampened signalling is not complete shutdown, killing or a diagnosis of exhaustion.
Selected receptor mechanisms and schematic molecular counts do not establish target eligibility, clinical efficacy or benefit.
The preserved family comparison distinguishes selected surface receptor mechanisms from intracellular receptors rather than one universal receptor location.
G-protein contact and a receptor-associated intracellular kinase/phosphorylated substrate are different selected relay roles.
Ions and ligand symbols are different objects; four ion beads and two kinase-receptor chains are schematic counts rather than measured molecular stoichiometry.
The entering-molecule/internal-receptor route differs from ligand binding at the outside face of a surface receptor.
The selected internal-receptor/nuclear route keeps the nuclear boundary and pore crossing distinct from outside binding; it is not a route required of every ligand.
Theme preservation, drawn relationships and a complete nuclear outline do not independently establish measured receptor biology, drug delivery or accepted scientific review.
